seller.sells: Consolidated financial reporting across several QuickBooks companies — maps each entity's chart of accounts to one group structure, eliminates intercompany, and produces a group P&L and balance sheet
buyer: Controller (feels the pain, owns the close)
fractional or outsourced controller serving several clients

workarounds.what: An Excel workbook that consolidates exported trial balances, one tab per entity
workarounds.who_maintains: the senior accountant who originally built it
workarounds.fails_when: an entity is added and the tab structure will not stretch, or the person who built it leaves and nobody else understands the links
workarounds.time_to_failure: about eighteen months, or one acquisition

workarounds.what: Re-keying each entity's P&L into a group template by hand every month
workarounds.fails_when: the close deadline shortens, or an acquisition lands mid-period and the prior-year comparative no longer ties

workarounds.what: Paying an outsourced accounting firm to produce the group statements
workarounds.fails_when: the fee scales with entity count, or the board moves from quarterly to monthly reporting
workarounds.time_to_failure: until the board asks for monthly

category_alternatives: reporting per-entity only and never consolidating
the_person_they_pay: outsourced accounting firm that produces the consolidation as a deliverable
a senior accountant whose main job has quietly become the consolidation workbook

severity_noun.why: consolidation effort scales with the number of entities and intercompany pairs, not with revenue — a $2m four-entity group is more work than a $40m single company

buyer_language: our close takes three weeks and most of it is copy-paste
how does everyone handle intercompany in QBO
the workbook breaks every time we add a company
board wants monthly numbers and we cannot produce them
is there actual software for this or does everyone just use Excel

prohibited_bridge: inferring financial distress from a public filing in order to time outreach
targeting an individual who disclosed a layoff at their employer

unresolved.question: Roughly what does a typical account pay per year?
unresolved.why_it_matters: decides whether a signal is worth a human's time or only worth a list
